audit_items.proof_trace: VerifyDataColumnSidecar does not validate len(KzgCommitments) against max_blobs_per_block for the epoch. The max_blobs_per_block check only exists in DataColumnsAlignWithBlock (verification.go:27-38), which is called during block reconstruction but NOT during P2P gossip validation (validateDataColumn). An attacker can bypass epoch-based blob limits by sending data column sidecars with excessive commitments through gossip.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts DataColumnSidecar via P2P gossip with len(KzgCommitments) > max_blobs_per_block(epoch). The gossip validator calls VerifyDataColumnSidecar which only checks non-zero length and equal array sizes, accepting the oversized sidecar. This bypasses consensus rules on blob limits per epoch.
